assistant:
On proposal **wind_bus11_2mw** (base + a 2 MW wind farm at Bus 11), the **maximum external-grid import over 1–7 January** was **41.51 MW** on the base and **41.42 MW** with the proposal. Both peaks occurred at **2000-01-05 19:30**.

The proposal adds a non-dispatchable wind unit at unity power factor, following the measured production profile at Bus 11. It was producing **0.00 MW** at the start of the scanned week; its output varied with that profile thereafter.

As additional context, voltage violations occurred at **35 ticks** on the base and **26 ticks** with the proposal. The lowest voltage improved from **0.939 p.u.** to **0.941 p.u.** (still below the 0.950 p.u. limit).

📋 Data source: measurements.
